title: NASA representative: 4,000 recorded cases a year

tellings.quote: when I talked with one of the NASA representatives, he says, "We officially record about 4,000 cases a year when people notice unidentified objects like saucers

plain: Around 1997 or 1998, a NASA representative is said to have admitted that "we officially record about 4,000 cases a year" of people seeing unidentified objects like saucers. Kiran Ilum Xenov, the former president of a Russian republic who says he was taken by aliens in 1997, tells Michels this is what the representative told him. If true, NASA would be quietly counting thousands of sightings a year.
